Pieces on the surface of a Platonic solid

Smallest edge s for P unit pieces. Every drawn packing is certified; its score is rounded to 6 decimals. Drag the solid to turn it. Red dots are the vertices (cone points).

* exact tiling. gain = how much smaller s gets with folding.

PolyPack surface research build. Data: data/surface/records.json (2038 records, generated 2026-10-24). Method and proofs: docs/spaces/SURFACE.md.
